approval_sequence: Whole-character redraw is authorized. Keep each named provider: configured API unless the user explicitly asks for built-in imagegen. Artistic acceptance remains pending.
drawing_scope: Transparent character only; subtitles, effects, background and separate props are post-production layers.

eye_style_baseline.drawing_rule: Curved black upper lash, dark charcoal iris with a simple gray lower segment, small white highlight and sparse lower-edge dots.
eye_style_baseline.expression_rule: Copy the drawing method only. Preserve each source frame's eye openness, expression and gaze; do not apply F858's half-lidded expression everywhere.
eye_style_baseline.user_selected_scope: Eye drawing method only; this does not accept the complete F858 image.

whole_character_rule: Generate a coherent whole character for visible costume, hairstyle, floating cap or seam failures. Preserve prior rejected versions; do not repair these by recombining separate head, cap and body images.
builtin_quality_note: High is the user preference; the built-in imagegen tool does not expose a quality or model parameter. Do not claim its parameter was verified as high.
